blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — Prosecutors have ordered the release of 236 members of the Lakbayani protest caravan who were detained for more than 70 hours following their arrest during a protest in Muntinlupa City, the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) College of Development Communication (CDC) said on Wednesday (Nov. 18).
